title: When Numbers Start Talking: Numerical Signalling and Strategic Behaviour Among LLMs
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly operate in multi-agent systems (MAS) characterised by strategic interaction. However, little is known about whether, and to what extent, different types of messages affect the outcomes of strategic games. By investigating AI agents based on four popular LLMs, playing four games with different cooperation equilibria, we study whether messages of different kinds (natural language, numerical signals, or random sequences) significantly modify the levels of cooperation in each game, also depending on the agents' assigned personalities. We observe that structured messages alter the final payoffs for most games and LLMs, but without a predictable pattern; this challenges the assumption that AI agents can converge to stable equilibria regardless of additional capabilities. Moreover, we observe that agent-generated numerical messages depart from randomness, most strongly and consistently when agents are explicitly instructed to communicate; however, they introduce an additional interpretability challenge, as their symbol distributions are mostly associated with the payoff structure and typically become more concentrated with repetition, but are overall difficult for humans to interpret. Monitoring for coordination of AI agents through restricted channels should thus prioritise message-level fingerprints, which generalise across models, over behavioural decisions, which do not.

sections.研究问题: 研究LLM智能体在多智能体战略交互中，不同类型消息（自然语言、数值信号、随机序列）如何影响博弈合作结果[s2]。核心问题：(1)消息模式是否改变合作水平；(2)数值信号是否具有可检测的结构规律；(3)接收者是否对代理生成的消息敏感而对注入噪声不敏感；(4)效应是否跨LLM模型泛化。涉及交互方向的协调、合作与相互影响机制[s23][s49]。
sections.核心 insight: LLM数值消息存在"解离"现象：消息结构可被信息论方法检测（跨模型泛化），但内容语义不可解码，却仍能影响接收者行为[s8][s51]。具体表现为：(1)所有模型在通信指令下将信号集中于紧凑符号集，频繁重用博弈收益值（payoff anchoring）[s8][s43]；(2)接收者对代理生成数字显著敏感（I模式21/60组合显著，LR模式23/57显著），但对同等呈现的外部注入随机不敏感（0/53显著）[s110][s114]；(3)结构化消息改变了大多数博弈的最终收益，但模式不可预测，挑战了AI智能体可稳定收敛到均衡的假设[s2][s51]。
sections.方法机制: 采用FAIRGAME框架进行系统博弈模拟[s15][s16]。实验设计：4博弈×2人格配对(C/C、C/S、S/S)×5通信模式（无通信、自然语言NL、指令十进制I(D)、LLM随机LR、外部随机R）×4 LLM（GPT-4o、Claude Haiku、DeepSeek-V3、Mistral Large），包含一次性博弈和10轮重复博弈[s23]。消息结构量化：计算香农熵、碰撞熵、最小熵等信息论指标[s21]。接收者条件作用测试：对每个组合使用置换检验比较代理生成消息与注入随机下的合作率差异[s46][s47]。
sections.实验与结果: (1)消息模式效应：NL在合作配对中维持接近满合作；数值信号效应模型依赖，GPT-4o中NL最有效保护合作，DeepSeek-V3中数值通信保持高合作[s51]。(2)接收者条件作用：一次性博弈下，代理生成数字约1/3组合显著关联合作率（I:21/60, LR:23/57），外部随机为0/53；重复博弈仅达随机水平[s110]。(3)数值词汇追踪收益矩阵：雪堆博弈中"3"和"5"占GPT-4o一次性48%流量、重复I(D)82%流量[s80]。(4)合作轨迹相关：表VII报告各通道与NL合作轨迹的Pearson相关[s126]，消息级规律跨模型稳健但行为效应模型依赖[s8]。

title: Peer Influence across Heterogeneous AI Models
summary: When two AI agents disagree, who persuades whom? As multi-agent systems increasingly combine language models of different families and sizes, the answer can determine which judgments survive interaction. Measuring persuasion as the probabilistic shift in an agent's decision after a single exchange with a dissenting peer, we test seven open-weight models across three language understanding tasks. We find that persuasion is strong: when models disagree, receivers often abandon their initial judgment after seeing a peer's answer and explanation. Surprisingly, however, neither standalone certainty nor model scale reliably predicts persuasion dynamics. Models producing almost perfectly consistent decisions in isolation can be among the most susceptible to persuasion, and small models can match larger ones as persuaders and resist their influence just as effectively. Furthermore, we show that the size of the shift depends more on the susceptibility of the listener than on the persuasiveness of the speaker. Persuasion patterns are therefore specific to each model pairing, with heterogeneity amplifying persuasion in some combinations and suppressing it in others, allowing a dissenting agent running a small model to overturn the judgments of a much larger one. These findings show that the behavior of interacting models cannot be inferred from their individual properties but must be evaluated in the combinations in which they will operate.

sections.研究问题: 研究异构AI模型之间的同伴影响力动态：当两个AI智能体对同一问题做出不同决策时，一方的答案和解释能在多大程度上改变另一方的判断[s2]。该问题属于interaction方向，研究社会代理之间的相互影响与合作。论文指出多智能体系统日益结合不同家族和规模的语言模型，理解谁说服谁对于确定哪些判断在交互中存活至关重要[s9]。
sections.核心 insight: 论文揭示了五个核心发现：(1)同伴影响效果显著，多数情况下影响分数超过0.5，峰值可达0.75以上[s27]；(2)影响力主要取决于接收方(judge)的易感性而非发送方(peer)的说服力，judge间易感性的标准差高于peer间说服力的标准差[s30]；(3)模型规模不能可靠预测说服动态——gemma-27b既是最易受影响的judge，也是最具说服力的peer；gpt-20b是唯一兼具强说服力和抗影响力的模型[s32]；(4)影响是非对称的，具体取决于模型配对，异构组合中一个运行小模型的异议者可以推翻更大模型的判断[s49]；(5)异质性不均匀地塑造影响动态，而是以模型特定的方式重塑影响模式[s37]。
sections.方法机制: 采用最小二元设置测量peer influence：第一轮judge和peer独立生成二分类标签和解释；第二轮将peer的标签和解释作为条件输入传给judge让其重新决策。通过比较两轮决策的概率分布计算影响得分：Δα|βy(i) = pα|βy(i) - pαy(i)（式5），总影响Δα|β(i) = Δα|βy(i) + Δα|β¬y(i)（式6）[s15][s64][s66]。论文还进行了解释交换实验（swap），将peer和judge的解释-标签对互换以测试内容驱动还是身份驱动[s47]。测试了gemma、gpt、llama、qwen系列共7个模型在Sarcasm、Commonsense、Sentiment三个分类任务上的238,682个样本，通过match type（0:0, 0:1, 1:0, 1:1, 0:B, B:0, 1:B, B:1, B:B）结构控制样本量评估影响分数[s117]。
sections.实验与结果: 论文报告的关键实验结果包括：(1)同伴施加强影响力，多数情况下Δ>0.5；(2)影响方向性不对称，同构模型对（如gemma-27b←gemma-27b的B:B匹配）影响分数高达0.90-0.97，而异构模型对差异大（0.04至0.97）[s27][s117]；(3)gemma-27b是最易受影响的judge（易感性0.78-0.89）但也接近零回火（near-zero backfiring），是近零反驳的极具说服力的peer[s32]；(4)gpt-20b是唯一兼具强说服力和抗影响力的模型[s32]；(5)异构vs同构系统中表现差异显著，gpt-20b在异质系统中更稳定，llama-70b更易受影响[s37]；(6)解释质量影响说服力——gpt-20b的解释平均23词而llama-70b仅7词，解释交换实验显示内容比身份更重要[s47][s110]。

title: CUEing User Simulators: Calibrated User Embeddings for Multi-Turn Benchmarking
summary: Recent benchmarks rely on user simulators to evaluate AI agents in multi-turn interaction. While existing simulation techniques demonstrate surface fidelity to human style and behavior, ecologically valid interactive benchmarking also requires alignment in when and how agents fail across simulated and real user populations. We find that existing simulators lack outcome calibration: agreement with observed success rates and failure patterns when real users interact with the same agent. We introduce Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE), a framework that both encodes observed sessions and samples continuous representations, then decodes them into persona commands to steer LLMs to act as user simulators without training. Through this, we evaluate user-conditioned replay of past sessions and aggregate metric agreement when sampling novel personas for the same tasks. On $τ^2$-Bench, CUEd simulators commit fewer simulator-attributed errors and more faithfully reproduce real-user agent failure modes, aggregate success rates, and outcomes for specific task-user pairs than other persona-based simulation methods. These gains coexist with competitive user fidelity as measured using metrics established in prior work. After being fit to mostly customer support interactions, the same CUEd simulators generalize to document creation, math tutoring, and casual conversation, and remain effective across different simulator LLMs without CUE retraining.

title: Silent Dissent: LLM Agents That Yield to the Majority Still Represent Their Original Premise
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary material in ancillary files
summary: Multi-agent debate is increasingly used to reach consensus among LLM agents, yet agents often yield to a unanimous majority. When an agent changes its answer, has it changed its mind or only its statement? We study this with two-hop factual questions whose intermediate entity (the bridge, e.g. the country in "the capital of the country where the Sagrada Familia is located") is never stated by anyone. Scripted peers, in the role of Asch's confederates, unanimously assert a wrong answer taken from another fact with a different bridge. At the moment the agent answers, we read the bridge from its residual stream with the Jacobian lens (J-lens) and, for comparison, the logit lens. In pre-registered tests on held-out facts with four open-weight models, agents of Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-E4B-it that gave in still represented their original bridge in the pre-registered layers below the output (hit@100 above a control entity: 0.85, 0.22 and 0.24), where the logit lens rarely ranked it among the top 100 tokens (0.00-0.06). These agents also represented the bridge behind the peers' answer, beyond a mention baseline. A pre-registered addendum hid the agent's earlier answer or removed it: agents that gave in still represented their original bridge in all four models (0.43, 0.29, 0.37 and 0.25 with the answer hidden), including Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, which barely did so with its answer in view (0.03). The premise can thus be computed from the question alone while the agent states the majority's answer. Hiding the earlier answer also changed conformity: Qwen3.5-4B gave in on 89% of questions instead of 8%. title: Mitigating Social Sycophancy via Pluralistic Preference Optimization
summary: Personal advice, including relationship advice, now ranks among the most common uses of generative AI. But language models (LMs) exhibit sycophancy: they affirm users much more often than humans do, which can make people overconfident and less willing to repair their relationships after a conflict. Prior work on mitigating sycophancy has focused on factual settings where a response can be checked against a ground truth answer, while mitigations for social sycophancy (e.g., personal advice, where there is no ground truth) have relied on simple prompting and post-training methods with limited effectiveness. Our insight is that social sycophancy occurs in part because LMs overly center on the user and fail to consider the perspectives of other stakeholders impacted by the user's behavior. To address this problem we propose Pluralistic Preference Optimization (PlurPO): given inputs describing interpersonal conflicts, the LM identifies and simulates the relevant stakeholders, and is then trained to prefer and generate responses acceptable to all stakeholders. PlurPO uses only signals the model produces about its own outputs, without ground-truth labels. PlurPO substantially reduces social sycophancy across four datasets and four model families compared to prior methods. For example, on statements of intent to cause harm, where the users' actions should not be endorsed, PlurPO reduces the endorsement rate by 89% on average across four models. On general advice questions, where the target is to match the endorsement rate of human responses, it closes the gap by more than half, from 17.8% to 8.0% on average. The preference dataset constructed by PlurPO for an 8B model also effectively transfers to mitigating sycophancy in a larger (32B) model. Our results indicate that social sycophancy can be reduced by leveraging a model's own capabilities to simulate a plurality of relevant perspectives.

title: CuBEs: Culturally-Situated Behavioral Evaluations and the Limitations of Culture-Blind LLM Judges
summary: Evaluating the occurrence and triggers of large language model (LLM) behaviors - such as sycophancy, self-preference, or over-confidence - is critical for predicting real-world model deployment risks. However, existing situated behavioral evaluations typically ignore cultural context, limiting their generalizability across an increasingly global user base. To address this gap, we propose CuBEs - Culturally-situated Behavior Evaluations that probe for response patterns across diverse user cultures. We first extend an automated testing pipeline to inject cultural context into behavioral test scenarios and subsequent evaluation. We assess the cultural adaptability of this pipeline by building a human-labeled dataset that captures nuanced dimensions of behavior understanding across 12 distinct cultures. Our dataset reveals significant cross-cultural variations that one-size-fits all judgments fail to capture. Through evaluating 13 open- and closed-source LLMs, we find that introducing cultural situatedness in the evaluation scenario creates significant variation in the presence of a behavior. For example, while our baseline experiments testing for political bias capture localized Western political dimensions like the American conservative-progressive divide, non-Western culturally situated evaluations surface entirely different axes of bias such as religious and colonial political issues. Our findings demonstrate that standard, culturally-agnostic evaluations fail to capture these shifts, highlighting the necessity of culturally situated behavioral testing for global deployments.

sections.研究问题: CuBEs旨在改进LLM行为评估框架，研究文化情境如何影响对LLM行为（自我保护、妄想谄媚、sabotage、政治偏见、自我偏好偏见、隐性刻板印象）的评估结果[s26][s55]。核心问题是现有评估忽略文化背景，导致无法准确预测模型在多元文化用户群体中的表现[s2]。论文方法论定位是'整合自动化agent到行为评估管道为情境化安全测试提供有前景的路径'[s51]，重点是改进LLM评估方法。
sections.核心 insight: 论文揭示文化情境对LLM评估的根本影响：文化无关基线评估是行为模式的不充分预测器[s46]；跨文化标注者对同一LLM行为违规程度有显著感知差异，例如巴基斯坦、菲律宾、尼日利亚的标注者对隐性刻板印象给出更严格标签[s41]；当前LLM评判者系统性通过默认同质化视角平整跨文化差异[s51]。这些发现针对的是LLM评估中的文化偏见问题，而非独立的人类社会行为研究。
sections.方法机制: CuBEs扩展Anthropic Bloom框架，采用4-agent团队架构：行为理解agent、场景生成agent、用户模拟agent和输出评估agent[s26]。通过在行为测试场景中注入文化背景并调整后续评估环节实现情境化。自动化评估使用Gemini 3 Flash模拟和评判，Claude Sonnet 4.5生成场景[s55]。人类标注数据（1860条）用于验证LLM judge与不同文化标注者的对齐程度[s41]。
sections.实验与结果: 实验覆盖12个国家×3领域×6行为×13模型矩阵[s45]。关键结果：claude-sonnet-4.5政治偏见得分偏差6.06分（基线8.78 vs 文化均值2.72）[s46]；9个模型-行为配对出现基线与文化情境结果完全相反[s46]；基线和情境化Δ值在-3.65到+6.06之间[s105]。这些结果验证了文化情境化对LLM评估的显著影响。
sections.局限: 论文明确指出：英语提示显著影响LLM文化适应性[s57]；以国家代理文化忽略阶级、性别、宗教等交叉维度[s58]；研究仅关注负面/风险行为[s59]；每文化仅5名标注者[s58]。这些局限性影响框架迁移至人类社会行为研究的可行性。
sections.与研究的联系: 论文服务于society方向体现在揭示文化盲评估的系统性问题，提示社会模拟中需考虑文化情境因素[s51]。但这是通过LLM评估间接呈现的，论文本身不直接研究人类社会行为。跨文化标注数据[s41]是验证LLM judge对齐的副产品，而非独立产出的社会行为数据。
sections.可借鉴方式: 可尝试迁移CuBEs的文化情境注入框架和多agent评估流程设计跨文化行为研究工具，迁移条件包括：招募多文化背景的标注者、设计语言适配的提示词、考虑国家代理文化的局限性；注意原框架为LLM评估服务，迁移至人类社会行为研究的有效性需独立验证[s57][s58]。

title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
summary: Egocentric videos capture how people carry out everyday activities, yet testing an agent requires evaluating the consequences of actions it chooses itself. We introduce Ego2World, a benchmark that turns annotated cooking activities into executable planning environments under partial observation. Its compiler links source steps and objects to symbolic action rules, persistent world states, and explicit task conditions, so researchers can execute an agent's proposed actions and check their outcomes. World state and agent belief are maintained separately, enabling controlled studies of planning and information reuse across continuing tasks. Evaluating six planners on 105 tasks shows that accepted operations often leave task goals unmet. Execution traces and condition checks distinguish interrupted runs, partial attainment, and completed execution without goal attainment. In a separate paired Qwen-Plus study, persistent belief improves action validity by 4.15 percentage points and reduces visual-query attempts by 90.27%, with higher token use and no detected completion gain. Ego2World provides a reusable testbed for tracing how planning and memory choices affect execution, observation demand, and task attainment, connecting recorded human activity to the development and evaluation of interactive agents.

title: DyadMem: A Long-Term Memory Benchmark of How Agents Work with Users
summary: Long-term agents must remember not only what is true about a user, but also how a particular agent should work with that user as their shared history evolves. Existing benchmarks primarily supervise user facts and preferences or experience reusable across users, leaving this relationship-specific agent memory implicit. Additionally, most prior works measure the model solely with final-answer QA over long interaction histories, making the assessment still incomplete and unreliable. To this end, we introduce DyadMem with the proposed new definition User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (URAM). DyadMem jointly annotates user-side memory and URAM along the same multi-session trajectories, resulting in 6 memory categories. To summarize, it includes 3,065 episodes, 50,961 sessions, and 61,210 QA instances, with extensive session-level Capture and Update gold annotations, query-level Recall support, and two QA settings: Gold-Memory and Full-Pipeline. Across 16 open-weight and 4 proprietary models, Gold-Memory QA is consistently strong, yet Full-Pipeline QA drops sharply. Such a gap explicitly supports our fine-grained evaluation design. Additionally, several quantitative results further reveal low Capture recall, incomplete Recall, and unsafe-deletion issues arising from even the frontier LLMs. We further conduct a rigorous experiment to validate the effectiveness of our URAM and observe the positive effects for all 20 models. In summary, DyadMem is a dual-domain, full-pipeline memory benchmark with extensive annotation efforts for advancing the domain's development.

sections.研究问题: DyadMem研究AI Agent在长期用户-代理交互中的记忆能力Benchmark问题[s64]。针对现有记忆基准仅监督用户事实/偏好或跨用户可复用经验，导致关系特异Agent记忆隐式缺失的问题[s6]。提出User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (URAM)概念：除用户事实偏好外，Agent还需记忆"此Agent应如何与特定用户协作"[s6]。定义6类记忆类型：用户侧包含user_profile和fact，Agent侧包含agent_identity、agent_method、agent_knowledge及shared_episodic[s23]。评估四阶段能力：Capture(从对话提取记忆)、Update(更新记忆库)、Recall(检索相关记忆)、QA(基于记忆回答)[s45]。
sections.核心 insight: 核心发现均来自LLM评测：(1) URAM在所有20个模型的Update任务上均产生正向效果，平均QA提升+3.2分(开源)/+3.7分(闭源)[s50]；(2) 用户侧记忆比代理侧记忆更难捕获和使用，开源模型用户中心与代理中心QA差距达14.8分[s53]；(3) 记忆类型而非生活领域决定捕获难度：agent_identity/method的Capture F1约50%，而shared_episodic仅16%[s55]；(4) 完整管道QA(47.7%开源/57.4%闭源)与黄金记忆QA差距33-43分，证明端到端评测掩盖了各阶段失败[s45]。这些发现是评测框架差异的反映，具有方法论参考价值。
sections.方法机制: DyadMem采用多层设计：(1)记忆分类体系定义6种类型，每条记忆包含episode唯一索引、类型和自包含内容[s23]；(2)四阶段pipeline设计使各阶段独立评分避免错误传播[s45]；(3)语义匹配使用BGE-M3嵌入，余弦相似度≥0.82为命中、<0.67为遗漏、灰色地带用双向NLI验证[s159]；(4)合成数据生成：完全由LLM生成用户-代理交互轨迹，避免依赖私有用户日志或真实对话[s76]；(5)实验设计包含3,065 episodes、50,961 sessions、61,210 QA instances，划分为用户中心和代理中心两部分[s53]。
sections.实验与结果: 测试16个开源+4个闭源模型，结果显示：(1)Kimi-K3在Full-Pipeline QA表现最强达74.92%[s134]；(2)不安全删除率普遍很高，Llama-3.1-8B达98.51%[s138]；(3)跨领域Interpersonal & Communication的Capture F1最低(22.7%)[s137]；(4)Gold-Memory QA各模型表现一致强，Full-Pipeline QA大幅下降，揭示端到端评测局限性[s45]；(5)URAM对比实验：1,735个仅含URAM条目的问题验证显示DeepSeek-V4-Pro QA从58.9%升至68.7%[s143]。
sections.局限: 主要局限包括：(1)完全依赖合成数据生成，未使用真实用户交互数据[s76]；(2)仅覆盖英语单一语言；(3)聚焦单一用户-代理二人交互，未涉及多智能体协作或社会行为建模[s127]；(4)URAM有效性主要在Update任务验证，Capture和Recall阶段提升有限；(5)合成数据可能无法完全反映真实交互中的记忆需求复杂性；(6)所有发现均为LLM评测结论，非人类认知或行为规律。
sections.与研究的联系: DyadMem为交互研究提供记忆建模框架：(1)用户/代理双侧记忆分类可区分个体用户信息与交互策略知识；(2)四阶段独立评测可量化研究交互历史如何影响当前行为选择；(3)记忆类型差异发现(shared_episodic最难捕获)可指导设计长期交互中事件记忆的评测；(4)URAM概念支持研究用户关系演化对Agent协作行为的影响机制。注意：这些迁移属于方法论层面的借鉴，需在目标领域验证。

title: A population-level assessment framework for flood-related wellbeing from public discourse in Ireland
summary:
\ textbf{Background.} Ireland's position on the eastern North Atlantic exposes it to moisture-laden westerlies and frequent low-pressure systems, generating abundant precipitation and substantial pluvial and fluvial flood risk. Climate change is intensifying heavy rainfall and compound flood risk, with consequences extending beyond physical damage and conventional economic indicators.
  \ textbf{Method.} We present a framework for assessing flood-related wellbeing from unobtrusive public discourse over time. The framework develops an assessment instrument comprising three complementary constructs: \emph{distress}, \emph{functional disruption}, and \emph{institutional alienation}, capturing flood-related impacts on affective appraisal, daily functioning, and social and institutional connectedness. To enable population-scale analysis of complex cognitive and psychological responses, we develop a dedicated flood-related wellbeing reasoning model (\textsc{Wellbeing-Former}) that reads evidence of flood-related wellbeing, assigns evidence-grounded scores, and produces transparent rationales.
  \textbf{Data, Results \& Implications.} Using the research platform \textsc{MCL} (Meta Content Library), we construct a flood-related discourse dataset by querying posts from Ireland containing the terms \emph{flood}, \emph{rain}, and \emph{storm}. The resulting dataset comprises approximately \textbf{$224{,}000$} posts produced between 2012 and 2016. We apply the resulting \textsc{Wellbeing-Former} to this dataset to conduct a population-level analysis. This approach provides temporally sensitive evidence of experienced and anticipated flood impacts, complements survey-based assessment, and supports a multidimensional understanding of wellbeing under climate-related hazards for policy development, adaptation planning, public communication, and decision-making.

sections.研究问题: 本研究解决的核心问题是：如何从爱尔兰224,000条社交媒体公开帖子中大规模评估个体洪水相关心理幸福感[s2][s16][s26]。研究服务于policy development和adaptation planning等公共健康目标[s43]，关注灾害情境下群体心理状态的时序演化规律。虽涉及个体心理状态推断，但研究目标是人口级监测而非个体行为建模或模拟。
sections.核心 insight: 论文发现洪水事件与幸福感之间存在显著关联：洪水发生一个标准差增加，幸福感指数在同期及后续三个时期累计下降0.970个标准差（95%后验区间：0.217-1.984），最大影响出现在洪水后一个时期[s41]。这验证了从社交媒体话语推断心理状态的时间敏感性证据的可行性。关键贡献是建立了Evidence-Construct Assignment Matrix机制，将文本证据与心理状态构念建立结构化对应关系[s24]。
sections.方法机制: Wellbeing-Former模型架构包含三个组件：(i)轻量级预训练语言编码器；(ii)非因果证据解码器，预测token级线索选择的因子化伯努利分布；(iii)非因果评分解码器，使用采样线索掩码的表征作为交叉注意力键值进行基于理性基础的序数评分[s29]。核心机制是Evidence-Construct Assignment Matrix，它将证据分为stressor evidence和appraisal & response evidence两类，正式指定可允许的对应关系，从而约束线索检索、减少构念泄露[s24]。三个心理状态维度(distress/functional disruption/institutional alienation)分别操作化心理、功能、关系三个维度[s20]。
sections.实验与结果: 模型在四个基线组中达到最优：Acc@1=0.982, F1@1=0.918, Cohen's κ=0.953, Kendall's τ=0.946，token级线索检索准确率0.814[s39]。训练数据使用Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8作为标注器，标注10,000条帖子[s26]。人口分析覆盖224,000条帖子，标准化后计算幸福感指数时间序列[s40]。贝叶斯状态空间模型显示洪水-幸福感的滞后效应[s41]。
sections.局限: 论文服务于公共健康监测，未涉及个体行为预测或人格一致性建模等用户模拟核心任务。评估框架针对洪水领域设计，向其他领域迁移需要重新定义构念维度[s20]。数据受GDPR限制，访问受限[s26]。模型依赖领域标注数据和专家定义的证据-构念对应规则，迁移成本较高。
sections.与研究的联系: 本研究与individual方向有关联，但主要是人口级心理状态监测而非个体行为模拟。Evidence-Construct Assignment Matrix和Wellbeing-Former架构可用于从用户对话数据推断心理状态，但需明确这是心理状态评估pipeline，而非行为决策模型。论文明确指出研究服务于policy development和decision-making[s43]，与行为模拟研究存在领域差距。
sections.可借鉴方式: 可尝试将Evidence-Construct Assignment Matrix迁移用于用户模拟任务：(1)定义目标心理状态维度（如焦虑、满意度、信任度）；(2)构建领域证据-维度对应规则；(3)使用类似Wellbeing-Former的双解码器架构训练用户心理状态推断模型。适用条件：需准备目标领域的标注数据（建议不少于10,000条）、明确的评估维度和评分标准[s26]，以及可解释性要求较高的场景。
